summary: Implemented Graph.cbd(resource) in rdflib/graph.py (last method of Graph, before ConjunctiveGraph) with a nested recursive helper implementing CBD rules 1 and 2 as specified, plus a docstring. Added test/test_graph_cbd.py (class CbdTestCase) covering rule counts, typed and untyped reifiers, incoming-reification exclusion, blank-node-in-reifier non-expansion, blank-node cycle termination, and source immutability. Tests were NOT run, per instructions; expected counts were derived by hand from the fixtures. Nothing was committed.
